lines.speaker: Aeacus
lines.text: Protesilaus — why have you jumped on Helen and started strangling her?

lines.speaker: Protesilaus
lines.text: Because of her, Aeacus, I died. I left my house half-built and my wife a widow on her wedding night.

lines.speaker: Aeacus
lines.text: Then blame Menelaus. He's the one who marched you all to Troy over a woman like that.

lines.speaker: Protesilaus
lines.text: Good point. [pause] Menelaus, you're the one I should be strangling.

lines.speaker: Menelaus
lines.text: Not me, my friend — in fairness, Paris. He was my guest, and he made off with my wife in flat defiance of every decent custom. That man deserves to be strangled not just by you but by every Greek and every barbarian alive — he's responsible for that many deaths.

lines.speaker: Protesilaus
lines.text: Better. [turning] Right then — Paris, you wretch, I am not letting go of you.

lines.speaker: Paris
lines.text: That's unjust, Protesilaus — and to a colleague, no less. I'm a man of love too. I was in the grip of the same god you were. And you know perfectly well it's not something we choose; some divinity drags us where it likes, and there's no resisting it.

lines.speaker: Protesilaus
lines.text: Fair point. [pause] If only I could get my hands on Eros down here.

lines.speaker: Aeacus
lines.text: Allow me to answer for Eros as well — in the interests of justice. He'll say that he may indeed have been responsible for making Paris fall in love, but for your death, Protesilaus, no one is responsible but you. You forgot all about your new bride. The moment you were running in on the Trojan coast, you flung yourself ahead of everyone else — recklessly, suicidally — out of love for glory. And that's why you were the first man killed in the landing.

lines.speaker: Protesilaus
lines.text: Then permit me, Aeacus, to answer on my own behalf — with a still better case. I'm not responsible for any of it. Fate is. It was spun out that way from the very beginning.

lines.speaker: Aeacus
lines.text: Quite right. [pause] So why are you blaming these two?
